fragments.text: Good afternoon. My name's Mrs Carter and I run the before and after school

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 下午好。我是卡特夫人，我负责课前课后的延长保育服务。

sentences.translation: 我希望你们已经好好参观了学校，并与教职工和学生交谈过。

fragments.text: I know that many of you are interested in using our childcare service when your child joins the school, and perhaps you already know something about it, but for those that don't, I'll go through the
now.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 我知道，当你们的孩子入学时，你们很多人都对使用我们的托儿服务感兴趣，也许你们已经知道了一些，但对于那些不知道的那部分，我现在将把主要的细节讲解一遍。

fragments.text: We offer childcare for children from the ages of four to eleven
school.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 我们为4岁到11岁的孩子提供学前和放学后的托儿服务。

who work find this service

sentences.translation: 我知道许多上班族父母觉得这项服务非常宝贵。

fragments.text: You can leave your child with us safe in the knowledge that they will be cared for

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 你可以把你的孩子安全地交给我们，他们会得到很好的照顾。

fragments.text: We are insured to provide care for up to 70 children, although we rarely have this many at any one
. I think we generally expect around 50 - 60 children for the

sessions.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 我们最多能同时照顾70个孩子，不过通常不论在哪个时段，都并不会有这么多人。下午时段一般都是50-60个孩子，而早餐时段只有这人数的一半左右。

fragments.text: Although we do have 70 children registered with us, not all of these attend every day.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 虽然我们目前有70名儿童注册，但并不是所有人每天都来。

fragments.text: It's ten years since we began offering an extended hours service and we've come a long way during that time.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 10年前我们开始提供延时（托育）服务，我们已经走了很长一段路。

fragments.text: When we first opened, we only had about 20 children attending

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 我们刚开业的时候，只有大约20个孩子定期来。

as low as we can and we think we
very good value for money.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 我们尽量降低价格，我们认为我们的产品物有所值。

fragments.text: For the afternoon sessions, which run from 3.30 until 6 p.m., it's

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 下午3点半到6点的课程是7.20英镑。

or two hours which costs

sentences.translation: 但如果你愿意，你可以只付一小时的费用，是3.5英镑，也可以付两小时的费用，是5.7英镑。

fragments.text: The cost of the childcare includes

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 儿童保育费用包括食品和零食。

fragments.text: They'll be given breakfast in the morning and in the afternoon, a healthy snack as soon as they finish school.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 早上我们会给孩子们提供早餐，下午一放学，我们就会给他们提供健康小零食。

sentences.translation: 下午5点时，我们会给孩子们一些如意大利通心粉或者炖菜类的比较有饱腹感的食物。

fragments.text: Please inform us of any allergies that your child might have and we'll make sure they're offered a

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 如果您的孩子对于任何食物过敏，请告知我们。我们会为他准备别的食物。

fragments.text: As you may know, the childcare service runs through the school holidays from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 如你所知，在学校放假期间，托儿服务从早上8点到下午6点。

fragments.text: We offer a really varied and exciting
to keep the children entertained - we don't want them to feel as if they are still at school!

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 我们提供了许多种类丰富且刺激有趣的项目让孩子们开心，（因为）我们一点儿也不希望孩子们在我们这儿的时候觉得自己仿佛还在学校。

with children from other schools -

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 在我们这儿是很不一样的，孩子们有机会去和来自别的学校的孩子交朋友。每个活动都有很多名额，因为不是所有孩子都会参加。

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 之前家长们有问11岁以上的孩子是否可以和他们的弟弟妹妹一起来，但由于我们的保险类型所限，我们恐怕不能这么做。

fragments.text: So now let me tell you about some of the
that your child can do during the afterschool sessions.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 现在让我告诉你们一些你的孩子在课后可以做的活动。

fragments.text: For example, Spanish. We have a
coming in every Thursday to give a basic introduction to the language through games and songs.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 例如,学习西班牙语。我们有一位专门的老师每周四来，通过游戏和歌曲让孩子们进行基本的语言学习。

fragments.text: She does two sessions: one for the over 8s and one for the younger children.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 她有两类课程:一个是针对8岁以上的孩子，另一个是针对更小的孩子。

for - but it's well worth it.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 这是我们唯一需要额外收费的活动，但它物有所值。

to do some

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 孩子们每周有一次玩音乐的机会。

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 我们很幸运，我们的一名员工是民谣乐队的成员。

fragments.text: On Mondays, she teaches singing and percussion to groups of children.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 星期一，她教一群孩子唱歌和打击乐。

and would be prepared to help out at these sessions, we'd be

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: （这点上）我们需要父母的支持，所以如果你们中有人唱歌或演奏乐器且愿意在课程中帮助我们，我们会很高兴。

fragments.text: continues to be one of the most

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 绘画依然是最受欢迎的活动之一。

fragments.text: To begin with we weren't keen on offering this because of the
involved, but children kept asking if they could do some art and so we finally gave in.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 起初，我们不想提供这个活动，因为它意味着又脏又乱。但是孩子们一直想要有艺术创作，所以我们投降了。

fragments.text: Art is great for helping the children to relax after working hard at school all day.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 艺术对于帮助孩子们在学校辛苦学习一整天后的放松很有帮助。

fragments.text: Yoga is something that we've been meaning to
for some time but haven't been able to find anyone available to teach it - until now that is.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 瑜伽是我们一段时间以来一直想引入的东西，但一直没有找到任何人可以教它——直到现在。

fragments.text: So we'll see how this goes.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 让我们看看这个活动效果如何。

ways from this.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 我们希望孩子们能从各类活动中受益。

fragments.text: Cooking is another popular activity.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 烹饪是另一项受欢迎的活动。

fragments.text: They make a different sort of cake, or pizza or bread each week.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Carter
sentences.translation: 他们每周做不同种类的蛋糕、披萨或面包。
